messages:
Lena: Quick sync: final pass on Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing copy + inbound lead flow. Need clear heroes + one benchmark/stat each + routing rules for forms.
Omar: I can take hero lines. Ideas: Hosted="Low-latency inference, zero ops"; Dedicated="Reserved GPU pools, predictable throughput"; Private="Air-gapped deploys with audit logs".
Casey: For experiments: Variant 1 = stat-first (show p95/tokens), Variant 2 = benefit-first (SLA/cost). 2-week run NA/EU.
Dina: HubSpot mapping sketch: mode_interest, company_size_bucket, compliance_flag. Rules: if company_size_bucket==enterprise or compliance_flag==yes -> assign solutions; else if company_size_bucket==midmarket -> assign ae; else -> sdr. Also add hidden field headline_variant.
Lena: Add webinar CTA on each page that sets webinar_opt_in=true and adds to benchmarks nurture list. Keep form under 5 fields.
Omar: I'll upload 3 hero mockups (text-only, text+stat, text+mini-survey). Mobile-first constraints: hero <=3 lines.
Casey: Tracking: append ?utm_exp=hero_v2&utm_var={A|B} and tag submissions with cta_id. We'll measure webinar conversion and MQL rate.
Dina: I'll post the automation JSON by EOD and create the HubSpot form fields.
alerts-bot: Meeting created: "Landing copy + routing review" tomorrow 9:30.
Lena: Perfect. Action owners: Omar=mockups, Casey=A/B plan+tracking, Dina=HubSpot rules, Lena=copy locks. Review in meeting and pick winners.
